title: Psoriasis
definition: Psoriasis is a chronic immune-mediated inflammatory skin disease characterized by well-demarcated erythematous plaques with silvery scale, commonly on extensor surfaces and scalp, with a relapsing-remitting course.

title: Atopic dermatitis
definition: Atopic dermatitis is a chronic pruritic inflammatory skin disease with eczematous lesions, typically in flexural areas, associated with skin barrier dysfunction and immune dysregulation, often with a relapsing course.

title: Contact dermatitis
definition: Contact dermatitis is an inflammatory skin reaction caused by direct contact with an irritant or allergen, presenting as erythema, vesicles or eczematous patches at the contact site.

title: Alopecia areata
definition: Alopecia areata is an autoimmune disorder causing non-scarring hair loss, presenting as well-circumscribed patches of hair loss on scalp or body, with a variable and often recurrent course.
